title: コンパクトバスシェルター
description: 曲面屋根、ガラス風防、固定金具、雨樋と無地の時刻表ケースを備えた座席なしのバス待合所。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: Seat-free compact bus shelter with curved aluminium roof, framed glass windscreens, foundation anchors, rain gutter, downpipe and blank timetable case. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
